errors.fingerprint: AAPT2: 'PNG chunk type 49444154 is too large' then 'Exit code 139' (segmentation fault)
errors.rootCause: A PNG that is cut off or has damaged data. The shipped static aapt2 crashes on it; with damaged pixel data it crashes without naming the file.
errors.repair: PngSanitizer: structure check of every PNG before 'aapt2 compile'; after a failure a thorough check (checksums, pixel data size). The damaged image is replaced by a valid PNG that keeps the readable rows, in the build's copy (or in a copy of the folder for imported and library resources). The user's image is not changed. Only drawable*/mipmap* folders are checked (res/raw is copied verbatim by AAPT2 and left alone). With checksum damage the rows below the damaged spot can be wrong, and the warning says so.
verifiedOn: JVM 17 with the shipped x86_64 aapt2: crash reproduced (exit 139) and gone after the repair, for cut-off RGBA/RGB/gray/palette/gray+alpha PNGs, a wrong-checksum PNG and a non-PNG file; independent review ran 117 valid PNGs of every type with no false alarm and 850 salvaged outputs that all open

errors.fingerprint: ECJ: X cannot be resolved + warning 'Local library ... is enabled but its classes.jar is missing'
errors.rootCause: The project's library list points to a library folder whose classes.jar is gone (folder deleted, moved, or only partly restored).
errors.repair: LibraryIntegrity at build start: restore from an .aar/.jar left in the folder; else download the same library again, but only when its coordinate is certain (recorded at install in source.json, or a well-known library with exactly that folder name). A name is never looked up in a repository: look-alike artifacts exist under popular names (found in review: appcompat, recyclerview, exoplayer under foreign groups on Maven Central). Only missing files are added; res, manifest and config in the folder are kept. A failed download is not retried for 5 minutes.

Min SDK 21+ unchanged. v1.8.4: the project's own DEX output is now several files (R classes of the libraries pass 64K fields) and the activities and Application were in the last one; DexOrder merges the files that hold code first, R-only files after.

errors.fingerprint: Generated app: Telugu vowel signs / ottulu cut at the top or bottom of a TextView, or touching the next line, with a custom font
errors.rootCause: The font's ascent/descent (hhea/OS2) are smaller than the shaped ink of stacked clusters; TextView reserves only the font metrics (plus the head bbox for the first/last line when includeFontPadding is on).
errors.repair: v1.8.4 SketchFonts.apply (font blocks): measures the font's own shaped ink for worst-case Telugu clusters and raises the line-spacing multiplier and top/bottom padding by what is missing; fonts whose ink fits change nothing.

errors.fingerprint: Export AAB: Play Console may refuse the bundle as unsigned ("The Android App Bundle was not signed"); jarsigner (JDK 17): "treated as unsigned, because it is signed with a weak algorithm"
errors.rootCause: The export screen signs the .aab with kellinwood ZipSigner / CustomKeySigner (upstream code), which always writes SHA1-Digest entries in MANIFEST.MF and CERT.SF, also with an own keystore and "SHA256withRSA". SHA-1 JAR signatures are disabled in current JDKs; a public report (B4X forum) shows Play rejecting an AAB with SHA-1 digests and accepting it with SHA-256.
errors.repair: none in v1.8.4: the owner asked to keep the signing pipeline untouched in this release. Needs his decision (AAB-only JAR signing with SHA-256 digests, e.g. apksig's V1 signer; APK export and ReleaseSigner unchanged).
verifiedOn: Android 12 ART harness: Export AAB of fixtures 908/909/910 with the test key; jarsigner -verify on JVM 17 shows SHA1 digests / SHA1withRSA
